instruction: Italicize the header text in row 1 of the spreadsheet (Date, Budget, Actual, Difference).

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent attempted to hide all rows with #N/A values by right-clicking row headers and selecting 'Hide Rows'. It misidentified which rows contained N/A, hiding wrong rows and missing some N/A rows. Used 50 turns but failed to correctly hide all target rows.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can right-click row headers, use context menus, navigate spreadsheet, select cells and rows. Demonstrated ability to interact with LibreOffice Calc UI elements.
metadata.failure_analysis: Model incorrectly identified which rows had #N/A values. Got confused by row numbering changes as rows were hidden.
metadata.task_rationale: Tests basic cell formatting capability in the same spreadsheet. Italicizing cells uses similar UI patterns (select cells, apply formatting via toolbar or Ctrl+I). Headers are currently bold but not italic.
metadata.explanation: Task asks to italicize header cells B1:E1. Getter reads font.italic property via openpyxl. Metric checks all 4 cells are italic with partial credit per cell (0.25 each).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly uses openpyxl cell.font.italic to extract italic formatting state for each specified header cell (B1, C1, D1, E1)

Partial credit scoring (0.25 per cell) is appropriate for a 4-cell verification task

All 4 headers listed in the instruction (Date, Budget, Actual, Difference) are covered by the evaluator
Error handling is present for missing file and getter errors
